name: Shadowguard Sentry

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Devourer’s Presence
traits.details: Any enemy that starts its turn within the aura is slowed until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Isolation’s Horror
traits.details: The sentry’s attacks deal 5 extra cold and necrotic damage against a target marked by it that has no allies adjacent to it.

auras.name: Devourer’s Presence
auras.details: Any enemy that starts its turn within the aura is slowed until the start of its next turn.

effect.description: The sentry marks the target until the end of the sentry’s next turn.

hit.description: The sentry pushes the target 3 squares, and the target is immobilized until the end of the sentry’s next turn.

miss.description: The sentry pushes the target 3 squares.

powers.name: Shadow Doom
powers.trigger: An adjacent creature marked by the sentry moves or shifts.

hit.description: The sentry slides the target 1 square, and the target gains vulnerable 5 cold and vulnerable 5 necrotic (save ends both).
